crossRefs.note: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and…
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
translations.bsb: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there were directors for the singers and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
translations.kjv: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
translations.asv: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
